title: DeploymentOpsContract
description: Machine-readable deployment entrypoint contract: OpenTofu owns the Cloudflare edge, the cluster fleet is provisioned declaratively by Cluster API + Talos (installation-media zero-touch) + per-cell Argo CD, the root Makefile owns operator entry, day-2 changes route through ops, and no manual SSH troubleshooting.

_meta.amendment_note: v2.0.0 (ADR-0375): retire the OCI/on-prem OpenTofu+shell deployment model. OpenTofu now owns only the Cloudflare edge; cluster lifecycle moves to Cluster API + Talos (installation media) + Argo CD. The infra/oci + infra/onprem trees and their shell-consolidation inventory are removed.
source_directives: no handrolling; declarative IaC and a minimal, intuitive bootstrap/Makefile.
once setup, everything managed through ops/GitOps.
no manual ssh command troubleshooting. just works out of the box.
everything from control plane to worker auto-installs from installation media; cluster lifecycle via CAPI, apps via Argo CD.

deployment_authority.rationale: OpenTofu declarative state owns the Cloudflare edge (tunnel, DNS, Zero Trust Access). The Talos cluster fleet is provisioned by Cluster API (declared in git, reconciled by controllers) — see cluster_fleet below; it is not a tofu root.

roots.state_policy: root-declared backend; tunnel, DNS, and Zero Trust Access are OpenTofu-managed

cluster_fleet.model: Cluster API + Talos + Argo CD (ADR-0375; supersedes ADR-0120/0121)
cluster_fleet.node_install: Talos installation-media zero-touch (infra/talos/installation-media) — control-plane config baked offline, nodes fetch config
cluster_fleet.cluster_lifecycle: CAPI (infra/capi): clusterctl init + Talos/OCI/AWS/Metal3 providers; spoke Cluster CRs in infra/capi/clusters/
cluster_fleet.bootstrap_addons: CAPI ClusterResourceSet installs Cilium + Argo CD per cluster (infra/capi/crs)

makefile.command_policy: Make targets may invoke cargo/Rust gates and tofu only (Cloudflare edge). They must not embed ssh troubleshooting, oci compute mutation, or terraform CLI. Cluster-fleet bring-up is git/CAPI-driven (see `make fleet`).

bootstrap_contract.goal: Cold-start the deployment toolchain without bespoke runbooks.
minimum_behaviour: validate this deployment contract with Rust
verify tofu is installed and point to official OpenTofu install docs if absent
avoid networked package installation except OpenTofu/provider downloads requested by tofu init
non_goals: run component shell install scripts directly

normal_flow: provision the cluster fleet via CAPI/Talos (make fleet) — git-declared, controller-reconciled
leave day-2 changes to ops-managed controllers + Argo CD
install_contract.confirmation_policy: OpenTofu apply prompts by default; do not use hidden auto-approve in the Makefile.

ops_management_contract.rule: After bootstrap/install, desired-state changes, drift repair, status, and incident workflows are initiated through ops, Argo CD, or repo-native Rust controllers, not ad hoc SSH sessions.
incident_flow: route fix through CI/CD hotfix PR, OpenTofu desired-state change, or Argo CD git change
do not page a human and do not manually SSH-troubleshoot

preconditions: active production safety incident where OpenTofu/CAPI/ops is unavailable
audit-chain row emitted before or immediately after action
follow-up PR restores declarative desired state
break_glass.normal_runbook: not present; break-glass is not a troubleshooting recipe

acceptance_criteria.rule: root Makefile exists and exposes all required targets
OpenTofu is the only deploy mutation authority for the Cloudflare edge; the cluster fleet is CAPI/Talos/Argo CD declared in git
manual SSH troubleshooting and OCI CLI mutation are explicitly forbidden
the deployment durable goal no longer routes incidents to page-on-call

verification_commands: cargo run -p oya-dev-cli -- gate validate deployment-ops-contract
